# The Home Depot Investor Relations

> The Home Depot's investor relations hub providing comprehensive financial data, stock information, SEC filings, corporate governance, and shareholder resources.

ir.homedepot.com serves as the central resource for investors and shareholders seeking financial reports, stock performance data, news releases, and corporate governance information. The site aggregates quarterly earnings, annual reports, SEC filings, and real-time stock information alongside executive leadership profiles and shareholder services.

## Key Topics

- Quarterly Earnings
- SEC Filings
- Stock Information
- Annual Reports
- Corporate Governance
- Board of Directors
- Shareholder Services
- News Releases
- Financial Reports
- Investor Relations
- Dividend History
- Stock Quote & Chart
- Computershare
- Events & Presentations
- Shareholder Resources

## Financial Reports & Earnings

- [Quarterly Earnings 2025](https://ir.homedepot.com/financial-reports/quarterly-earnings): The Home Depot quarterly earnings reports and financial results
- [Quarterly Earnings 2025 Data](https://ir.homedepot.com/financial-reports/quarterly-earnings/2025): The Home Depot 2025 quarterly earnings financial data and results
- [Annual Reports Recent](https://ir.homedepot.com/financial-reports/annual-reports/recent): Recent annual reports and 10-K filings for The Home Depot
- [SEC Filings](https://ir.homedepot.com/financial-reports/sec-filings): SEC filings and regulatory documents for The Home Depot
- [Current Forms](https://ir.homedepot.com/financial-reports/current-forms): Current SEC forms and regulatory filings for The Home Depot

## Stock Information & Performance

- [Stock Quote & Chart](https://ir.homedepot.com/stock-information/stock-quote-and-chart): Real-time stock quote and chart data for The Home Depot
- [Dividend History](https://ir.homedepot.com/stock-information/dividend-history): Complete dividend history and payment information for The Home Depot

- [Stock Splits](https://ir.homedepot.com/stock-information/stock-splits): Historical stock split information and details for The Home Depot

- [Analyst Coverage](https://ir.homedepot.com/stock-information/analyst-coverage): Analyst coverage and research reports for The Home Depot stock
